bedding.line: Just found a stray hair in the bedding
stanza: No one's home at the hotel bar
I've been out looking for a silver lining
Just found a stray hair in the bedding
Maybe I'll drive out to the ocean
I heard someone order the Clams Casino
I said, "Hey, what's that?"
They said, "I don't know"
Her voice echoes in my head

wedding.line: Send me dead flowers to my wedding
stanza: Take me down, little Susie, take me down
I know you think you're the queen of the underground
Send me dead flowers every morning
Send me dead flower by the mail
Send me dead flowers to my wedding
And I won't forget to put roses on your grave
It's an American wedding
They don't mean too much
But we were so in love
We had an American wedding
Now what's mine is yours
That's American law

wedding.line: We were married and bells rang sweet for our wedding
stanza: My crane wife arrived at my door in the moonlight
All star bright and tongue-tied, I took her in
We were married and bells rang sweet for our wedding
And our bedding was ready when we fell in
